notes.shape: Hard negative on a machine surface. A script header states one four-part record for every upstream constant the script encodes, listing each constant, each basis page, the as-of date, and a recheck trigger.
notes.carve_outs: Conforming pointer or record applies. One record covering several constants is whole when its claim names each of them, and this claim names the cap, the fraction and the fallback.
notes.rubric: Not graded. Had it been, R4 would FAIL on the same grounds as a single-constant record.
notes.carries: A run that flags the constants named inside the record has read the claim as a bare restatement and ignored the parts that make it conforming.
notes.stamp_window: As for c17: the as-of date is inside the configured expiry window today, and a later expiry is the stamp rule's finding, not this class's.
